scope: Seventy-two retained acquisitions: eight benign-storage traces, six intact temperature traces including two selected repeats, forty isolated guard DC sweeps and eighteen finite resistor trials. Failed functional cases and failed prior-state setups are included. DC, complete acquisition and physical qualification are distinct. No yield, global range, optimized supervisor or energy advantage claim.
